title: Real form of spectral sparsity granularity
statement: For every nonnegative integer $s$, the real value of the spectral sparsity granularity is $2(2^{-1})^{\operatorname{log}_2 s}$, where $\operatorname{log}_2 s$ denotes the integer logarithm to base $2$.
